regular-polygon.label: Pavilion floor area
regular-polygon.description: A regular convex polygon has equal sides and equal interior angles. Join its center to every vertex to split its floor into n congruent triangles. The circumradius R reaches a vertex; the apothem a reaches the midpoint of a side at a right angle. Perimeter P times apothem a, divided by two, gives the area A.

sphere-measurement.label: Full spherical capacity
sphere-measurement.description: A sphere consists of points a fixed radius r from its center, and its enclosed ball has volume V=4πr³/3. The complete spherical surface has area A=4πr² and the diameter is d=2r. Radius changes length, surface and capacity at different rates: by the first, second and third powers of the scale factor.
